mostWorthwhile.text: Making dung beetles and fertile grassland was most worthwhile: it showed how grazers’ waste supports another animal and contributes to renewed growth.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting soil after the failed predator-and-soil pairing was least useful; neither revealed a route forward, though they ruled out possibilities.

surprise.text: The failed attempt to put small furred animals in grassland automatically led to scent tracking, then hunting mammals. I had expected herbivores instead.

arbitrary.text: Using shore plants and a rain shadow to make grassland was a plausible landscape guess, but the combination alone did not explain why that particular vegetation appeared.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the interconnected world develops; the waste-to-growth sequence and final food web made the ecological relationships engaging.
